# AIDD Commons

> An English-canonical learning and reference system for AI drug discovery.

## Product entry points

- [Learn](/learn/foundations/getting-started/): Start with the AIDD pipeline and connected learning pathways.
- [Atlas](/atlas/): Inspect source-grounded resources with evidence, caveats, licences, and openness dimensions.
- [Labs](/labs/): Find reproducible exercises with frozen data and evaluation contracts.
- [Audit](/audit/): Inspect bounded, source-adjacent coverage comparisons without treating unknowns as absences.
- [Report](/report/): Read the living technical context for methods, data, benchmarks, and process knowledge.
- [Contribute](/contribute/): Propose source corrections, lessons, labs, or other evidence for review.

## Use notes

- English is canonical; `/zh-cn/` provides onboarding and pathway navigation in Simplified Chinese.
- Treat `unverified` fields as unknown rather than as a positive or negative claim.
